response.sql: WITH rating_metrics AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, per_day_price, per_day_price / AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_rating_per_day_price FROM rating_metrics

assumptions.assumption: The simple mean across ratings gives each of the five rating levels equal weight, as requested; the per-day price for a rating is the ratio of that rating's average rental rate to its average rental duration.
